levels.name: Society
levels.description: The sequel to Escalator and a nerfed impossible level. Featuring a dreamcore/weirdcore aesthetic, it is filled with references and explores themes of mental instability. Currently the hardest rated level in Geometry Dash.

levels.name: Thinking Space II
levels.description: An official sequel to Thinking Space. Unlike the original, its decoration is in a glow design style, but it's more similar in gameplay as it has several gameplay references to the original and is also extremely end carried. The first top 1 in many years that was not built intentionally to be top 1.

levels.name: Flamewall
levels.description: Almost seven minutes of extremely fast and challenging gameplay, using a similarly very fast and dramatic symphonic metal song, and featuring very few break sections for its length. Features a gargantuan roster of creators and took multiple years to come out, in part thanks to the verifier dying at 99% twice.

levels.name: Amethyst
levels.description: A former top 1, dethroning Tidal Wave after two years. It's inspired by the Golden, with cave decoration with rocks, geodes, and purple and pink crystals. The gameplay consists of a lot of extremely hard wave and ship gameplay.

levels.name: Tidal Wave
levels.description: A former Top 1 and Onilink's first rated level, featuring incredibly difficult wave sections spread over its 3 minute runtime. Unlike most other top 1s, this level takes a very different approach to its style, theming it around the ocean and the beach with its blue and yellow colour scheme.

levels.name: ORBIT
levels.description: Another satisfying MindCap project tackling the theme of orbs. According to MindCap, this is the toughest project he and his roster have ever worked on with multiple creators dropping the level. Don't fall into The Ball Pit™.

levels.name: Nullscapes
levels.description: The sequel to Shardscapes and the current hardest level to use one gamemode, that being robot. Expanding on its predecessor, it features more noticeable progression, an orb cycling gimmick and most importantly much more unforgiving gameplay. Includes a CBF blocker which has sparked a significant amount of controversy within the community.

levels.name: Quanteuse processing
levels.description: An uncanny and extremely raw superbuffed remake of the main level Blast Processing, with gameplay by Renn241 and Blankb. Not meant to be a serious level.

levels.name: BOOBAWAMBA
levels.description: The current hardest memory extreme, themed around a dark abandoned factory with limited visibility. Features a randomized ending where five details throughout the level determine whether or not to click their corresponding toggle triggers. Built over the course of two years and thousands of hours, Akunakun considers this his magnum opus.

levels.name: Every End
levels.description: The hardest endurance level in Geometry Dash, featuring over 7 minutes of simple yet brutal 1.0 cube timings. Its difficulty balancing and specific skillset have lead it to being very accessible for a top level. Despite its simple 1.0 aesthetic, its technically impressive background effect involved the usage of third party software developed by Absolute.

levels.name: Silent clubstep
levels.description: One of the most legendary and recognizable levels in Geometry Dash. Formerly impossible and was initially hack-verified by Sailent in 1.8. Houses the "8 Jumps of Hell" and the infamous 6% ship part, among other classic sections.

levels.name: Ashley Wave Trials
levels.description: A level with a pink/red color scheme that is entirely wave, as the name suggests. The level remained unrated until CBF was added to the game and the level was eventually rated a while later.

levels.name: Ultra Paracosm
levels.description: Superbuffed remake of Hyper Paracosm, decorated by declanlc. Sadly not the easy demon

levels.name: andromeda
levels.description: Relatively unknown considering it's difficulty. Pink and purple space themed level with incredibly high-CPS gameplay and flashy visuals. Took over a year to be completed.

levels.name: Subsuming Vortex
levels.description: The hardest nine circles level currently on the list. It was created all the way in 2018 by SeptaGon7 and redecorated by Renn241. The name is a reference to a Calamity Mod spell tome with the same name.

levels.name: Anathema
levels.description: Legendary finale of the Dedication Series that took over 6 years to be finished and verified. Reminiscent of many different styles throughout 2.1.

levels.name: Avernus
levels.description: Well-known, poorly received, but unexpectedly enjoyable hell themed extreme which has gone through its fair share of controversy. Recognizable for its fixed hitboxes and ridiculous ship and wave sections.

levels.name: Acheron
levels.description: Iconic sequel to Tartarus. Intimidating 1.9 styled level that gradually gets less red and more black as it continues. Known for its impossibly tight wave sections & chokepoints.

levels.name: Spectre
levels.description: Zodiac sequel that was in the works for 4 years. Vaguely cool-toned with many parts by some of the most famous creators, like CuLuC, Darwin and Helpegasus.

levels.name: Menace
levels.description: White, orange and black effect level with plenty of lore and an entire poem within it. Includes some incredibly unorthodox gameplay. The level's song was also created by the creator, Arraegen, specifically for this project.

levels.name: Abyss of Darkness
levels.description: Iconic megacollab with an equally as iconic song. Originally was finished in 2018, but was redecorated in 2021. Known for its slow gameplay and very inconsistent decoration quality.

levels.name: Defeated Circles
levels.description: A Nine Circles styled level which takes heavy inspiration from the "You So Defeated" challenges, being especially apparent in the level's timing-based segments and its song choice. The level is overall first-half heavy, though the difficulty does not step down much in the latter half, ending off on a dual wave and a spam corridor.

levels.name: Tunnel of Despair
levels.description: Timing based greyscale level with red as its secondary color. Decorated exclusively by ivyteal. Generally repetitive with poorly received gameplay. Verification also features Zoink admitting to "hacking" Eternal Moment.

levels.name: Kyouki
levels.description: Blue and purple glowy effect level and Demishio's 3rd extreme demon project. Memorably high quality gameplay and effects with an iconic Creo song.

levels.name: Based After Based
levels.description: Initially a top 10 made without spikes and entirely dual gameplay that avoids speed changes. The verifier somehow fluked the level from 78%.

levels.name: The Lightning Rod
levels.description: Distinct and incredibly creative extreme themed around traversing and escaping the inside of an electric tower/rod. Supposedly one of the learniest levels on the main-list with extremely high-cps and quirky gameplay.

levels.name: Slaughterhouse
levels.description: Former top 1 with some of the most iconic wave sections in the game. Memorable for how incredibly intimidating the gameplay is, paired with an extremely washed out menacing song. Nowadays its been able to be completed 3 times in a row.

levels.name: Subterminal Point
levels.description: Generally underwhelming Trueffet sequel with classic SyQual visuals. Has an incredibly low enjoyment rating with appalling chokepoints and hitboxes, paired with a bubbly song.

levels.name: KOCMOC
levels.description: Formerly CherryTeam's hardest level. Although the level is mostly flashy pink and purple, it takes heavy inspiration from Slaughterhouse and mostly consists of tight wave spam and straight-fly. Pronounced as "cosmos".

levels.name: Deimos (ItsHybrid)
levels.description: Extremely large megacollab and remake of Phobos. Parts significantly vary in design and color similarly to Phobos, and the iconic final dual was kept nearly identical.

levels.name: CHIL
levels.description: A pure solo project which started out in early 2.2 and took over a year to verify. To fit its Camellia song, the visuals are extremely trippy with relentless camera effect usage and rapid pulses, which are especially apparent in the second half.

levels.name: Sakupen Circles
levels.description: Flashy nine circles level known for its lack of balancing and iconic wave sections. Remake of the 1.9 impossible level of the same name, and was briefly top 1.

levels.name: Eyes in the Water
levels.description: Well known for its unique decoration, unique "eye" theme, and iconic song. Includes a very strange cast of creators, with Bli, ivyteal, and skywalker14 all participating. First ship is incredibly difficult.

levels.name: Voltage (ThePurgatory)
levels.description: A yellow/orange electricity themed level created by The Purgatory team that took roughly four years to finish. Strangely it is pretty underground for its difficulty.

levels.name: KOSETSU
levels.description: Strange wintery realism collab with incredibly talented creators like Bli & Motheye. Uses an incredibly strange atmospheric song and goes a little crazy with 2.2 shaders.

levels.name: Through The Gates
levels.description: An initially hacked-verified level in 2018 that went through several stages. Even though it was verified in 2023, it took another three years for the level to get rated alongside other historical levels. Some say this level is a spiritual successor to Thinking Space.

levels.name: Firework
levels.description: Iconic greyscale former top 1 by CherryTeam. Loaded with classic sections like the red-orb ship and the difficult wave burst at 49%. Surprisingly not wave and ship carried.

levels.name: CONVULSION
levels.description: The hardest 1.9GDPS level, taking on a red, black and blue colour scheme with very flashy visuals and a menacing atmosphere. Its gameplay is very learny with many fakes and structures blending in with the decoration, and features a difficult ship section halfway through.

levels.name: poocubed
levels.description: The 3rd level in the poocu series, consisting of some of the most colorful and innocent decoration on the list. Known for its high-cps off-the-grid gameplay, as well as overall maximum bubbliness.

levels.name: MINUSdry
levels.description: Half-joke and half-serious old styled extreme. Remake of the impossible level "Silent Dry". Don't get wet...

levels.name: Saul Goodman
levels.description: The hardest extreme in the Breaking Bad series, overall not supposed to be a serious level. Incredibly learny gameplay where everything is moving and bouncing, also filled to the brim with inside jokes. Atrocious endscreen.

levels.name: Apocalyptic Trilogy
levels.description: Legendary but poorly received extreme that combines and superbuffs Cataclysm, Bloodbath and Aftermath. Took roughly 5 years to be finished and verified and has incredibly rough quality inconsistency.

levels.name: Sevvend Clubstep
levels.description: Industrial, minimalist cherry team level that's pretty click-sync.

levels.name: The Hallucination
levels.description: Black and blue circles level known for its intense song and fast-paced sync gameplay. Decoration took over a year to be completed.

levels.name: COMBUSTION
levels.description: Claustrophobic 1.9 styled extreme with only about 50 seconds of gameplay. Created to be one of the hardest slow, timing based extremes at the time.

levels.name: Loops of Fury
levels.description: Grayscale effect level that contains sections where the gameplay loops several times over (hence its name). Has a very chokeable ending.

levels.name: Deadlier Clubstep
levels.description: Maximalist authentic 1.9 level with some of the densest decoration on the list. Vague remake of Deadly Clubstep and Silent Clubstep, mimicking the classic cube-ball dual. Has its fair share of edgy text sprinkled throughout.

levels.name: Stellar Night
levels.description: Infamous icedcave solo extreme that took 3 years after its verification to get rated. Features intense learny and flow gameplay known for its difficult wave and ship sections. Decoration consists of classic and somewhat minimalist icedcave designs with muted colors and harsh atmosphere.

levels.name: Edge of Destiny
levels.description: Beloved remake of classic extreme Blade of Justice. Stays very true to the original, but significantly enhances the decoration and buffs the gameplay into a bright and glowy masterpiece.

levels.name: Solar Flare
levels.description: A remake of Solar Circles, with warm colours and blue highlights. Consists of unique structuring and a lot of movements on the structures. Also features Janet, the sun at the halfway point.

levels.name: The Catacombs
levels.description: Very old 1.9 GDPS level built as an upcoming top 1 in 2019. Was verified by Slithium in 2024, and rated in 2026.

levels.name: LIMBO
levels.description: Legendary memory level hosted by MindCap. Built with the intention of providing a unique, different experience to players. The randomised key maze is perhaps most iconic ending in any extreme. One of the first extremes to have merch.

levels.name: Gaggatrondra
levels.description: Bright and energetic level using Problem by Ariana Grande. Includes a memorable dual with intense and quirky high-cps gameplay. With the level containing a sign pointing to the "Zunty Realm", this extreme clearly is not meant to be taken too seriously. The most enjoyed level in the top 150 according to EDEL.

levels.name: Belladonna
levels.description: Gameplay by Vernam, effects and structuring by Itami. Memorable for its flashy visuals and high-cps flow gameplay.

levels.name: Codependence (Solo)
levels.description: 2-player megacollab released in 2020 by TCTeam. It took roughly 3 years after the level's release for it to be verified solo. Aged surprisingly well.

levels.name: Collapse (Nexel)
levels.description: Colorful XL click-sync solo design level using the second half of Dimrain47's Infernoplex. Memorable for its flashy rainbow effects and song representation. Contains an entire 10 second dash-orb at 76% to optimize the amount of nerves. 🐟

levels.name: Mayhem
levels.description: Construction themed CherryTeam collab mostly memorable for its off-sync sync-based gameplay. The LDM is perhaps a little too strong...

levels.name: The Plunge
levels.description: Atmospheric and floaty vortex themed extreme with a washed out song that takes loose White Space inspiration. Very memorable endscreen with a realistic hand.

levels.name: walter white
levels.description: The 2nd hardest level in the Breaking Bad series, and arguably the least interesting. Consists of typical Renn241 styled decoration with great colours and a severe lack of move triggers.

levels.name: Operation Evolution
levels.description: The third hardest 1.9 GDPS level which features 5 minutes of memory gameplay!

levels.name: Damascus
levels.description: Incredibly large megacollab 3 years in the making in which many classic creators (such as Tygrysek and Rob Buck) would remake their own most important level to them as their part. A level serving as a collage of diverse creating styles and scattered memories over the years, and was fittingly released on Geometry Dash's 10 year anniversary.

levels.name: SARYYX NEVER CLEAR
levels.description: SARY NEVER CLEAR and Hard Machine inspired design extreme with bright colors and heavy 1.9 influence. Gameplay is also loosely inspired by the aforementioned levels, with tight straight-fly and multiple brief spam sections.

levels.name: The Yangire
levels.description: Well-received sequel to The Yandere. Inconsistent but incredible art and designs with parts almost 3 years old before being finished. Took over 130,000 attempts to be verified.

levels.name: Climax
levels.description: Typical purple glow-flow extreme heavily inspired by Kyouki, using the same song.

levels.name: ORDINARY
levels.description: Bright and flashy early 2.2 extreme with a classic The Living Tombstone song that gets awkwardly pitched down at 59%. Generally very poorly received by victors. forgive no run please stop die haha

levels.name: Wavterminal
levels.description: Vibrant & hyper-saturated level that takes full advantage of shaders and gradient triggers. Includes spirals of swirling colors pairing well with its energetic song. One of most enjoyed extremes in the top 150!

levels.name: Sinister Silence
levels.description: 1.9 style extreme memorable for its nearly 9 minute runtime and incredibly large catalogue of creators. Utilizes a high-energy progressive rock song that easily gets your hands shaking as you progress.

levels.name: Midnight
levels.description: An extremely flashy, fast-paced and high cps sequel to Twilight. Consists of a vague space theme and brief misaligned dual section. Supposedly a collage of Yuko's older levels.

levels.name: Cimmerian Shade
levels.description: Extremely early 2.1 former impossible level that got rated completely out of the blue. Consists of unusual gameplay and a completely invisible section at 90%.

levels.name: PSYCHOPATH (DeniPol)
levels.description: Extremely unique extreme with a vague asylum and hallucination theme. The level's concept has supposedly been floating around since 2019. Caused controversy by being unrated after the verification was found to be using click between frames.

levels.name: arcturus
levels.description: Dark hell-themed level with a song straight out of a horror movie. Recognizable for its iconic fast-paced wave sections and 16% of the level being a black screen. Formerly an impossible level, and was part of the triple top 1 rate alongside Slaughterhouse and Firework.

levels.name: BEELINE (Solo)
levels.description: Very vibrant splitscreen 2 player level with the parts being references to various games. Includes some tricky and fast-paced gameplay, with the beginning being the hardest one.

levels.name: Sonic Wave Infinity
levels.description: Superbuffed Sonic Wave remake hosted by APTeam and Riot. 5 verifiers were involved and the level was briefly unrated because of its infamous 69% crash trigger that could corrupt save data. Supposedly, Riot hosted this megacollab because he felt the original Sonic Wave was "boring".

levels.name: Tartarus
levels.description: Infamous 1.9 styled megacollab with a long history of verifiers, a revamp, and controversies. A remake of the impossible level Silent Akbar. Reigned as an overwhelmingly intimidating top 1 for more than 17 months.

levels.name: Coalescence
levels.description: Fast-paced and intriguing fusion of extremes Fog and Shimmer. Consists of an entire minute of 4x speed gameplay. The song is also a collab by the artists involved in the two levels combined here. Features a randomised ending that is much more complex than the one found in Fog.

levels.name: Waterfall
levels.description: Legendary long awaited high-octane icy megacollab by CherryTeam. Known for its intense song and extremely high-effort and realistic art created by the likes of Bli, CuLuc and kivvvi. Originally was meant to be a Firework sequel.

levels.name: Jigsaw
levels.description: Learny high-cps level themed around the Saw movie series. Features a stacked cast of realism and effect creators with an overwhelming amount of sharp objects and edgy text throughout. Particularly memorable for it's clean transitions and background effects.

levels.name: Delta
levels.description: Intensely colorful and very sleek design megacollab hosted by Drakosa and Artsiburn. High-cps spinoff of the greek letter series (Gamma, Sigma & Omega) and memorable for its flashy effects and incredible colors. Also features a very satisfying drop-down out of the section at 67% into a new one to the song's key change.

levels.name: BPATA MPAKA
levels.description: A 2.2 Russian Mega-collab originally made to be a top 1, which was later changed. The level is based on the novel Master and Margarita.

levels.name: The Wonder of You
levels.description: Claustrophobic monochrome extreme with subtle blue/purple accents. Uses a memorably strange industrial song matching the unconventional name and detailed mechanical designs. Initially, it was supposed to be top 10, but was nerfed to roughly top 25 to prioritize playability.

levels.name: Natural Disaster
levels.description: Formerly impossible flashy green extreme with a vague nature/jungle theme. Features incredibly fast-paced wave sections and fast-paced gameplay. Stolen assets were found in the original version of the level, leading to the level getting unrated and getting a redecoration. Respect the Planet.

levels.name: The Golden
levels.description: Legendary green and yellow jungle themed extreme that reigned as top 1 for over 100 days. Known for its extremely difficult wave sections and dark atmosphere. A remake of LMAnubis' El Dorado that very nearly didn't exist. I verified the golden lets go

levels.name: Oblivion
levels.description: Claustrophobic and colourful sequel to the equally claustrophobic Cognition. Loses the old fashioned style song for a more upbeat Creo song, similar to Carcano. Surprisingly one of the most dropped extreme verifications, going through 6 verifiers.

levels.name: Viprin UFO
levels.description: Retro 1.9 styled extreme that only uses the UFO gamemode. Gameplay is much harder than it looks due to the unpredictable click-patterns and sketchy routes. Includes an upbeat Waterflame song and references to Pacman and Flappy Bird levels.

levels.name: NETWORK (Agat3)
levels.description: Fast-paced greyscale neo-design collab acting as a sequel to the easier Framework. Contains a memorably tricky spider at 55%

levels.name: Terminal Rampancy
levels.description: Xyriak's magnum opus that was worked on for over 3 years. It is extremely frantic with its gameplay and consists complicated usage of the dual mode, making it difficult to approach and learn. Unfortunately does not use the robot game mode.

levels.name: Verdant Landscape
levels.description: A pure solo level built and verified over the course of two years. Taking heavy inspiration from Windy Landscape, it features a green colour scheme, fast-paced, flowy gameplay and mesmerising Woogi-style symmetrical duals. Highly praised amongst the community for its fun gameplay and charming visual style.

levels.name: UNKNOWN
levels.description: Redecoration of the 1.9 styled level of the same name. The completely greyscale decoration and unnerving song makes for a generally unsettling experience. Also one of the shorter extremes on the list, being less than 45 seconds.

levels.name: ATOMIC CANNON Mk III
levels.description: The third installment of the ATOMIC CANNON series and the first to include features from the 2.2 update. The level follows gameplay elements from the first level compared to the second, with the cps not being as high; however, a wave part is included instead of a ship. Similar to the first installment, the last ball is a homage to Lieb's very first solo level, "Relativo," by featuring several designs from it.

levels.name: Shukketsu
levels.description: Learny Kowareta inspired "art-core" level with a groovy breakbeat song and colorful desaturated visuals. Features a slight garden theme and is flooded with community inside jokes and memes. The gameplay itself is clicksync and fast paced, with many chokepoints throughout the level.

levels.name: Checked Steam
levels.description: A Sequel to the level "Check Steam" by Gruzy, the level is known for its absolutely brutal spam sections specifically crafted for WhizKid05 to verify. Gameplay is generally hated by the community except for two victors who loved it.

levels.name: Critical Heat
levels.description: Fast-paced extreme themed around escaping a burning facility. Contains a lot of scaled up animated fire objects and high octane gameplay, along with a difficult dual. The hardest PEACEFUL! level in the game.

levels.name: WOBBLING MACHINE (Solo)
levels.description: 2 player extreme where one player has to perform standard gameplay as the other player clicks in a repetitive pattern, matching the rhythm of the 'wobbling' technique in Smash Bros. Melee. Originally hack verified and unrated, but later nerfed and re-verified after which it took over two years to get re-rated.

levels.name: Crystal Crusher (Solo)
levels.description: Simplistic crystal cave themed extreme. Majority of the level features convoluted and long misaligned duals.

levels.name: limbo but uwu ig idk
levels.description: Really bright and blinding rainbow level with a crazy wave teleporting maze at the end of it.

levels.name: The Paroxysm of Rage
levels.description: Superbuffed remake of Paroxysm to the point of almost copying. Slightly upgrades the visuals, and adds an extension with some glitchy effects.

levels.name: Aerial Gleam
levels.description: Bright blue storm themed circles level that gradually gets more decorated and flashy as it continues. Known for spawning the "CuLuC lightning" trend and for its difficult wave sections. Official sequel to Aquatic Auroras and the third level in the Weather Trilogy with 4+ verifiers.

levels.name: Starlit Stroll
levels.description: Simplistic atmospheric level that gets more visually complex as it continues, eventually developing into a fast-paced psychedelic and starry swirl with a slower ending. Memorable for its few gamemodes but incredibly difficult ships, waves and swing sections.

levels.name: Henken
levels.description: A megacollab with an entirely Polish creator roster notable for its muted colours, timing-based gameplay and difficult wave sections near the end. Much of the difficulty also lies in the first half, and contains the occasional fixed hitbox here and there.

levels.name: Trueffet
levels.description: Memorable blue and pink SyQual extreme with extremely difficult ship, wave, and spam sections. Originally was top 3 (even technically being top 1) and features numerous iconic high-cps wave sections. Named after Trueffet Square from Maple Story.

levels.name: azure blast
levels.description: An entirely Korean megacollab with a blue colour scheme and very difficult flow gameplay. Each part is distinctive with various decoration and gameplay styles as with many Korean collabs, with chokepoints found towards the middle third of the level. The first list level to use a song from the game's built-in NCS music library.

levels.name: Kenos
levels.description: 2019 buffed and extended remake of Sakupen Hell. Formerly top 2 and has some terrible hixboxes and 4+ verifiers. Recieved unparalled attention at the time for the verifier npesta's insane reaction became a meme across the internet.

levels.name: Fragile
levels.description: Megacollab and superbuffed combination of kowareta and unrated extreme Shibireta. Many community members on Twitter were advocating for Fragile to get rated, starting the popular #RateFragile hashtag.

levels.name: chrome hearts
levels.description: Roadbose's sendoff to the ICE Carbon series; a core-styled level built in the 1.9GDPS with symmetrical structuring, abstract shapes and highly detailed designs. Its 2m 30s runtime consists of difficult ship and wave sections, separated in the middle by a minute-long guitar solo interlude with easier gameplay.

levels.name: Starlight Summit
levels.description: A pure solo extreme using only the robot gamemode where the player traverses through treacherous alpine terrain. It combines traditional pixel style decoration, editor particles and a C418 song to create a cozy atmosphere. Don't let its short length fool you, it is filled to the brim with brutal robot timings, spike corner jumps and double clicks, especially in its middle section.

levels.name: Esfera
levels.description: Fast-paced Korean megacollab using a primarily blue and pink color scheme. Over 4 minutes long and memorable for its inconsistent style and bubbly song, as well as its fast-paced gameplay and chokepoints.

levels.name: Silent Lunch
levels.description: XXXL 70-person megacollab hosted by DreamTide. Originally was intended to be a joke level, but ended up being higher quality than expected. Consists of loosely 2.0 design styled decoration with relentlessly high energy gameplay and limited breaks. Notably uses the entirety of its song while taking pride in its inclusivity and well-playtested gameplay. Reportedly captures the difficulty of trying not to laugh during a Silent Lunch.

levels.name: NEUTRA
levels.description: Extremely bouncy and high-energy level with incredibly flashy effects and designs. Contains a memorable dual wave at 23% along with other quirky click-sync gameplay gimmicks and a very hard ending. The music collective 'siximpala' created the song and significantly helped plan the level's visuals.

levels.name: Swing Swing
levels.description: A swing-only extreme demon with a super creative name hosted by Kaza. Went unrated for a really really long time

levels.name: Guideless Goobering
levels.description: Colorful rainbow memory level acting as the finale in the Enfur's Entourage trilogy. Features lots of bright and cluttered decoration and unique effects. Memorable for its tricky misaligned dual at 77%
